quote: A sheltered life can be a daring life as well. For all serious daring starts from within.
source: Eudora Welty, One Writer’s Beginnings, III, Finding a Voice, the closing lines (Harvard University Press, 1984)

evidence.where: Independent secondary witnesses quoting the book’s last lines (the NEH Humanities feature on Welty, the Christian Science Monitor, a writing-coach essay), all agreeing on the wording and on its place as the close of Finding a Voice; the Harvard text is in copyright and no scan was opened
evidence.edition: One Writer’s Beginnings, Harvard University Press, Cambridge, Mass., 1984
evidence.locator: part III, Finding a Voice, the last two sentences of the book, after As you have seen, I am a writer who came of a sheltered life

reason: The two sentences are the close of the book, which ends part three, and the witnesses agree on every word. The quotation starts at a sentence boundary, so nothing is cut inside a sentence. Welty has no line this year.
